method: Build a non-live research engine that labels historical impulses with future bars, makes replay decisions only from completed point-in-time bars, selects captured 0DTE contracts at observed ask, exits at later observed bid, detects chop, records reproducible metrics and missed/caught moves.
owner_request: Owner explicitly requested backtesting the proposed aggressive move-attacker using all available captured timestamped SPY bars and options tables.
before_state: No SURGE trader exists. Captured bars span multiple August sessions and captured quote/chain snapshots exist; existing live competitors and their private code are out of scope.
reason: Owner explicitly requested backtesting the proposed aggressive move-attacker using all available captured timestamped SPY bars and options tables.
intended_scope: New SURGE research/backtest files and tests, backtest receipts, necessary governance records. No live launch, no brokerage orders, no changes to BLACKTIDE/RIPTIDE/private competitors or shared updater.
expected_effects: Produce an honest causal backtest showing detected impulse moves, chop avoidance, observed ask/bid option P/L, misses, false positives, and limitations of current captured data.
required_tests: No-lookahead labels/decisions, point-in-time contract fills, chop rejection, fingerprint/receipt, focused tests, execute actual captured-data backtest and report exact results.
risks: Sparse bars/options overlap, hindsight leakage, interpolation fantasies, overfitting; fail closed when no contemporaneous option snapshot exists and separate labels from decision inputs.
next_safe_action_if_interrupted: Inspect captured schemas/session overlap, implement causal impulse detector and replay runner, test, execute, and record receipt.
